name: Runway Agent
desc: Conversational agent that plans and produces a finished video
desc_zh: 对话式智能体，从创意到成片视频一步步生成
solves: Writing a brief, picking models and stitching shots by hand takes hours; describe the video instead and refine it in one conversation.
solves_zh: 以前写脚本、选模型、拼镜头要花几个小时；现在描述想要的视频，在对话里逐步修改即可。
best_for: A product launch film is due Friday and the brief only exists as a paragraph; open Agent and start talking.
best_for_zh: 周五要交产品发布短片，手头只有一段文字简介时，打开 Agent 直接开聊。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://runway.com/news and https://runway.com/changelog (entry 'May 13, 202）。 Agent 2.0 followed on 2026-06-25 (https://runway.com/news/introducing-agent-2: 'Today, we’re introducing Agent 2.0, an upgraded Runway Agent experience'). Agent Skills (changelog 2026-07-02), Agent Workflows (2026-07-23) and Timeline in Agent (2026-07-09) are later additions to the same surface, not separate entries.
